limitation.detail: GitHub UI states that rulesets will not be enforced on this private repository until the organization moves to a GitHub Team organization account. Live branch metadata continues to report main protected=false and protection enforcement off.

ownerDecision.decisionSource: Explicit repository-owner instruction in the active DE.PULSE continuation session

residualRisks: GitHub does not technically prevent a direct push to main under the current plan.
GitHub does not technically enforce the required Fast and Qualified statuses before merge under the current plan.
GitHub does not technically block force-push or deletion through protected-branch enforcement under the current plan.

compensatingControls.detail: Normal DE.PULSE changes continue through a development/work-slice branch and pull request; direct-to-main changes remain prohibited by governance.
DE.PULSE/fast-head must pass on the exact candidate SHA before merge.
DE.PULSE/qualified-head must pass on the exact candidate SHA when required by the governed work-slice/release process.
Direct pushes to main are prohibited even though GitHub cannot technically enforce the rule on the current plan.
Force-push and branch deletion of main remain prohibited by DE.PULSE governance.
Public Stable publication still uses the single canonical G11-G16 path with exact-source/native/no-rebuild assurance.
Candidate SHA, source fingerprint, build/evidence identity and artifact provenance remain immutable evidence owners.

revalidationTriggers: GitHub makes private-repository ruleset enforcement available on the current plan
A second maintainer or developer gains write access
retirementCondition: Enable and verify actual main protection/ruleset when enforcement becomes available; retire this waiver only after live GitHub evidence reports the control enforced.
